steps.label: Identify a, b, c and find √(a²+b²)
steps.margin_note: First mark. This one HAS a constant, and it is −13. It shifts both answers down by 13, so it cannot be ignored.
lines: Comparing with a sinx + b cosx + c:

accept: a five b twelve c minus thirteen and the root of twenty five plus one forty four is thirteen
identify the constant as minus thirteen and the root as thirteen
root one sixty nine is thirteen
a five b twelve c minus thirteen, root thirteen
the amplitude is thirteen and the constant is minus thirteen

steps.why: The amplitude happens to equal the constant here, which is why the maximum lands exactly on zero — a neat coincidence worth noticing as a check.

steps.label: Apply the max and min formulas
steps.margin_note: Second mark. The constant shifts everything down: max = −13 + 13 = 0 and min = −13 − 13 = −26. The function never rises above zero.

recall.must_convey: That the maximum is 0 and the minimum is −26.
accept: minus thirteen plus thirteen is zero and minus thirteen minus thirteen is minus twenty six
maximum zero and minimum minus twenty six
the constant shifts both down so the max is zero
maximum zero, minimum minus twenty six
the answers are zero and negative twenty six

steps.why: A maximum of exactly 0 means the function touches the axis at its highest point and is negative everywhere else — the constant is doing all of that.
common_mistakes: Giving 13 and −13 by dropping the constant.
Adding the constant to only one of the two.
